Variable (depends on the state of the lake; fish once every 20 h)

The {wiki:Lake Equivocolao}, north of Port Hope, is the only place where the rare {item:Shimmer Swimmer} lives, but the fish only appears when the lake is filthy. The server's players throw corpses into the lake; after 1000 corpses, the lake becomes dirty at the next server save and you can try to fish a Shimmer Swimmer. After 50 you get the achievement **Biodegradable**.
Lake Equivocolao is the only known home of the Shimmer Swimmer, but it only appears when the lake is filthy.
Lake Equivocolao, north of Port Hope
No minimum level; level 20+ recommended (jungle creatures on the way).
1 per character every 20 hours, with luck
Ask a {wiki:Guide NPCs|guide NPC} about *Twisted Waters* to learn the state of the lake without going there (see the table in section 2).
The {item:Shimmer Swimmer} is said to turn into a piece of equipment if used with certain items (see the item's wiki page).

In **Port Hope**, head **north** of the temple and the depot to the {wiki:Lake Equivocolao}. Next to the lake is the fisherman {npc:Yawno}, almost falling asleep from waiting so long. If you are not in Port Hope, take a boat (tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s dock. To return, take the same path **south** to Port Hope and take Charles's boat.
On the way there are {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Filth Toad|Filth Toads} and other jungle creatures.
2. Checking the state of the lake
Say {key:hi} and {key:fish} to {npc:Yawno}. The answer tells you what state the lake is in.
Enough bodies: it gets filthy at the next server save
Filthy, but more than 1000 items have already been fished
If the lake is clean and blue, kill creatures nearby and throw the bodies into the water. **1000 bodies** are needed in total, summed across all players on the server.
When {npc:Yawno} says *"It becomes dirty! All will be dirty! Yes! That's enough!"*, there are already enough bodies. The lake turns into a brown, filthy soup **after the next server save**.
What the filthy lake looks like after the server save
With the lake filthy, use the {item:Fishing Rod} on the lake water. There is a chance you will fish up a {item:Shimmer Swimmer} (you may also get {item:Fishbone|Fishbones}).
Each character can only fish **1** Shimmer Swimmer every **20 hours**.
After 1000 Shimmer Swimmers and Fishbones have been fished, nobody can fish any more in the lake and it becomes clean again at the next server save.
After fishing **50** Shimmer Swimmers you receive the achievement **Biodegradable**.
The 1000-body counter is shared by the whole server: the more players help, the faster the lake gets filthy.
